name: com.gameyogi.utilitytools
description: A lightweight set of Unity Editor productivity tools: inspector [Button] attribute for MonoBehaviours and ScriptableObjects (with parameters, coroutines, return values & confirmation), scene switcher overlay, inspector lock, play-from-bootstrap, live time-scale control, and one-click settings / asset shortcuts.

samples.description: A MonoBehaviour and a ScriptableObject showing every [Button] option: modes, colors, confirmation, parameters, coroutines and return values.
